request: Build a headless Jac API for a project tracker. Represent projects and tasks as graph nodes. Create root and nested projects, add tasks, browse each project hierarchy by ID, approve draft children recursively, and delete a task or project from traversal. Keep the public project and walker function names and fields grounded in the source repository. Implement the API without a browser UI or AI provider.
acceptance: Creating a root project and a sub-project makes the child discoverable under its parent and by ID.
Creating a task under a sub-project makes it discoverable through that project.
Approving a draft task or project clears is_draft, and deleting a task or project removes it from traversal.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 in an API-only project with no JSX or browser UI.
Use models/Task.jac, models/Project.jac, walkers.jac and main.jac as a dependency-aware cross-file implementation.
Preserve Rui/pm source function signatures and observable graph behavior.
